infrared-standing-units.name: IWT Pedestal-Mount Infrared Unit — 1 Module
infrared-standing-units.summary: Microprocessor-controlled infrared curing system with non-contact pyrometer measurement, INR compensation, process alarms, PC parameter transfer, and short-/fast-medium-wave emitters. Cassettes can be positioned in three axes to follow the part profile. Includes 16 programmable recipes, EPROM storage, system-to-system data transfer, and two-level password protection.
infrared-standing-units.description: The pedestal-mount IWT infrared unit provides focused, repeatable heat for industrial coating cure. Its adjustable stand positions the cassette around the part, including difficult-to-reach areas, while closed-loop surface-temperature control adapts energy output to the programmed cure cycle. Concentrating energy on the required area can shorten cycle time and reduce unnecessary heating of the surrounding workspace.

lampara-infrarroja-de-pedestal-iwt-2-mod.name: IWT Pedestal-Mount Infrared Unit — 2 Modules
lampara-infrarroja-de-pedestal-iwt-2-mod.summary: Microprocessor-controlled two-module infrared curing system with non-contact pyrometer measurement, INR compensation, process alarms, PC parameter transfer, and short-/fast-medium-wave emitters. lampara-infrarroja-de-pedestal-iwt-2-mod.description: The two-module pedestal IWT system provides adjustable infrared coverage for faster, controlled coating cure. Its movable stand and positionable cassettes target the required area, while integrated temperature control supports repeatable cycles for paint booths, repair operations, and industrial coating applications.

lampara-infrarroja-de-pedestal-iwt-3-mod.summary: Microprocessor-controlled three-module infrared curing system with non-contact pyrometer measurement, INR compensation, process alarms, PC parameter transfer, and short-/fast-medium-wave emitters. Includes three-axis cassette positioning, 16 programmable recipes, EPROM storage, and two-level password protection.
lampara-infrarroja-de-pedestal-iwt-3-mod.description:
The three-module pedestal IWT system provides broad, adjustable infrared coverage for controlled coating cure.
Temperature range:Controller programmable from 6 °C to 180 °C; minimum temperature-change rate 6 °C/min
